# The policy for each clang-tidy check that reports in the gate, shown under the check on the run page.
# One line per check: "<check>: <policy>". Read by .github/scripts/gate_summary.py.
bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters: Reports three or more adjacent parameters of one type (MinimumLength 3, set in the gate script on 2026-11-22; pairs are mostly x, y). Four are accepted: createGraspableBox and setColor in cl_moveit2z are to be changed in its rework, and CbNavigateGlobalPosition and Pose2D in cl_nav2z keep (x, y, yaw) for compatibility. The functions the lttng macros generate are suppressed in trace_provider.hpp. A new one is to be fixed before it is added, with a parameter struct as in the cl_px4_mr pattern behaviors.
bugprone-narrowing-conversions: Enforced: a new one is to be fixed with an explicit static_cast. The baseline holds none since 2026-11-22.
bugprone-misplaced-widening-cast: Enforced: a new one is to be fixed by casting the operands before the arithmetic. The baseline holds none since 2026-11-22.
cppcoreguidelines-pro-type-member-init: Enforced: a new one is to be fixed. The baseline holds none: the last four were given an initializer on 2026-11-22.
bugprone-exception-escape: Accepted for main(): an exception that reaches it ends the node, which is the intended outcome.
bugprone-integer-division: Accepted where listed: the division is the intended leg number of the square spiral. A new one is to be read.
bugprone-reserved-identifier: Accepted for the lttng header guard, whose name the lttng macros require. A new one is to be fixed.
clang-analyzer-core.CallAndMessage: False positive in signal_detector.cpp, kept in the baseline. A new one is to be read as a possible defect.
bugprone-unused-return-value: False positive in http_session.cpp: shutdown() also writes its result to the error code passed in, which the next line checks. A cast to void does not silence the check. A new one is to be read.
cppcoreguidelines-owning-memory: MISRA C++:2023 rule 21.6.2, added 2026-11-19; the 27 it gave then were fixed by 2026-11-20 and the baseline holds none. A new one is to be fixed: an event is created with smacc2::makeEvent, anything else with make_shared, make_unique or an owning member.
cppcoreguidelines-no-malloc: MISRA C++:2023 rule 21.6.2. The one it gave, the free() of the string abi::__cxa_demangle returns in introspection.hpp, is gone: demangleSymbol calls boost::core::demangle, which releases the string inside Boost's header. The baseline holds none. A new one is to be fixed.
